name: powershell-format
description: Formats PowerShell with Invoke-Formatter and reports PSScriptAnalyzer lint findings at git pre-commit, as two separate entries, only where a PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1 governs the file; optionally lints uncommitted changes when a turn ends. No lint autofix runs, and hooks never run an ecosystem record's command.

powershell_format_enabled.title: Run the session hooks
powershell_format_enabled.description: Turns the end-of-turn check and the session-start probe on or off. The git pre-commit entries are registered by /powershell-format:setup apply install-git-hooks and are not affected.

powershell_format_end_of_turn.title: Check PowerShell in uncommitted changes at turn end
powershell_format_end_of_turn.description: At the end of each turn, run the pre-commit lint entry over the lines changed since the last commit and hand any findings back so they are fixed before the turn ends, at most once per turn. Nothing is rewritten. Off by default.
